note: Migration map of the first lecture into chapters c00 and c01 (Smoke A). One entry per item of latex/lectures/de/vl01.tex as parsed by evidence/migrations/check_vl01_map.py: sections, display equations, environments, figure inputs, list items and paragraphs of running text. 'item' is '<kind>@<line>'. status: kept (destination = IDs in content/c00-theorie or content/c01-wahrscheinlichkeit, or registry definitions transcluded there), deferred (to a later chapter, with reason) or dropped (with reason). The English edition latex/lectures/en/lec01.tex has the same structure line for line and goes to the same destinations in en.tex. Updated in the Lecture 1 revision of 2026-10-20 (voice restoration from the script and the recorded lectures v01, v02; see the notes of the changed entries).
